## Summary

Describe the user problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `npm run lint`.
- [ ] I ran `npm run typecheck`.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests, including `npm test` when feasible.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I added or updated regression tests.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] Document bytes remain local, or the changed data flow and approval are
      explained below.
- [ ] No customer documents, personal data, credentials, secrets, or production
      records are included.
- [ ] Resource limits and trust boundaries are unchanged, or the security
      analysis and tests are explained below.

## Licensing and documentation

- [ ] New dependencies and assets have reviewed licences and updated notices.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated where needed.
- [ ] If I am an external contributor, my CLA acceptance is recorded through
      the repository's designated CLA workflow.

## Details for reviewers

Explain material tradeoffs, migration concerns, screenshots, or follow-up work.
